name: UNDRR Stop Disasters Game
description: This benchmark tests an AI agent's skill in disaster risk reduction by placing it in the role of a risk manager tasked with building safer communities against earthquakes, floods, tsunamis, and wildfires. Players allocate limited time and resources across infrastructure, education, and planning to minimize damage when disaster strikes.
reputation: Widely used global educational tool by the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction, translated into 11+ languages and played by millions
notes: Interactive browser-based simulation; performance reflects long-term strategic foresight rather than static recall; regularly refreshed with new languages and mobile support

institutions: UNDRR (United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction)
